Quicknode on GIWA

GIWA RPC, Streams and Webhooks.

GIWA is an Ethereum L2 on the OP Stack, so it is EVM-equivalent and your existing tooling works. Hosted RPC, a managed ETL pipeline for chain data, and onchain alerts. No node or indexer to run.

Network

GIWA Sepolia

Chain ID 91342, full archive access. Mainnet endpoints follow the network launch.

RPC

HTTPS and WSS

JSON-RPC, Debug and Flashblocks APIs over HTTPS. WebSocket for subscriptions.

Streams

ETL for onchain data

Extract live and historical GIWA data, transform it with your own code, load it into webhooks, S3, Postgres or Snowflake. No indexer to run.

Webhooks

Onchain alerts

Fire a webhook when a GIWA condition is met. Good for ops, bots and user-facing notifications.

First requestquicknode.com/docs/giwa
# HTTPS: latest block
curl https://<your-endpoint>.quiknode.pro/<token>/ \
  -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,
       "method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[]}'

# WSS: new heads as they land
wscat -c wss://<your-endpoint>.quiknode.pro/<token>/
> {"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,
   "method":"eth_subscribe","params":["newHeads"]}
Create the endpoint in the Quicknode dashboard: pick GIWA, pick Sepolia, copy the URL. Under a minute.
